title: the module walks (feasibility, safety, monitoring, amendment)

findings.claim: feasibility step 7: New request offers "Find candidates for the next visits" (SCREEN) and the plain-words field "goes to the conversation engine"; nothing on the box says that note criteria, screening and the engine need a GPU. Master has no no-GPU form: the steps-mode box runs the stub model, so SCREEN runs here
findings.expected: on a box without a GPU, the pages say what waits for a GPU (note criteria, SCREEN, the engine) and do not offer it as if it ran
findings.from: D-1066 ruling 1; `deploy/install.sh` --mode stub ("note criteria wait for a GPU"); lane D's second card

findings.claim: safety step 16: the participant's page offers "Add an adverse event" in a new study that has no forms; the link opens the data-entry page, which says "This study has no forms yet. Add the built-in forms or import a REDCap data dictionary on the page: Forms"
findings.expected: the AE form opens from the participant's page, or the page says the study's forms are to be added first

findings.claim: safety step 17: after adding the forms, no link leads back to the participant; the walk goes to My studies and the study card's "Participants" (as H-20 F-07)
findings.expected: a way back to the page the coordinator came from (the participant)

findings.claim: safety step 17: the AE line says "Reporting clock: no due date yet: enter the onset or the day the site learned of it" though both days were entered; the cause is the study's missing SAE rule set
findings.expected: the clock names its cause: the study's rule set is not chosen (`sae.flag.unconfirmed`)

findings.claim: safety step 18: the new SAE has no report and no deadline: "TrialBox tracks no report for this kind of SAE", "The study has not chosen its SAE rule set". The new study counts as open with no state recorded, so its type for SAE reporting was never asked (as H-20 F-14)
findings.expected: a trial does not open until its type for SAE reporting is chosen, so a serious AE of an open trial always has its deadlines

findings.claim: safety step 18: the steps-mode box has no trial office mailbox: the register says "This box has no trial office mailbox (TB_SAE_OFFICE_MAILBOX): a new serious adverse event is mailed to the study's PI only"
findings.expected: the steps-mode box set up as a site is (a test mailbox for the trial office), so the office's copy can be walked

findings.claim: safety step 19: the type check of D-415 is reached only by pausing the study (its lists and list mails stop) and opening it again: a study with no state recorded offers no "Open"
findings.expected: the type is asked when the study is first opened (or the set-up says it is missing)

findings.claim: safety step 23: the notice the box recorded reads "page=office_copy to=<the PI's mailbox> event=ae1": the action is labelled "page" and given as a code, in every language
findings.expected: the audit row says in words that the new SAE was notified, and to whom

findings.claim: safety step 24: Notices received lists the morning lists only: the SAE notice the box recorded as mailed to the PI (audit `office_copy`, step 23) is not there
findings.expected: "The notices TrialBox mailed you, newest first": the SAE notice among them

findings.claim: monitoring step 1: the refusal says "If you need it, ask the TrialBox administrator to change your role"; the monitor grant is given by the PI the log names or the data steward, and the administrator is refused it (step 3)
findings.expected: the refusal of a monitor's page says who grants: the study's PI or the data steward

findings.claim: monitoring step 3: the steward's menu and home page have no link to a study's delegation log once its PI is named; the walk types /studies/GZQO/team
findings.expected: a way from the steward's pages to each study's delegation log, where the steward grants

findings.claim: monitoring step 5: the sheet's "Consent given" and "Enrolled on" read 2026-11-17 (the day the seed recorded the steps, the real day) while the consent form's date on the same sheet and the state's day read 2026-11-02 (the box's day)
findings.expected: the sheet's dates agree with the forms a monitor verifies them against

findings.claim: monitoring step 5: the state reads "On study (on_study, 2026-11-02)": the code on_study is shown in every page language
findings.expected: the state in words with its day

findings.claim: monitoring step 7: the PI reaches the monitoring visit records only by typing /studies/GZQO/monitor: no link on the study's pages, the weekly page or the delegation log
findings.expected: a link to the monitoring visits from the study's pages for the PI who grants them

findings.claim: amendment step 16: patients are named by an 8-character pseudonym only; the walk takes the worklist's first row (as H-20 F-03)
findings.expected: a patient the tester can be told to take

findings.claim: amendment step 17: the field reads "New ruleset id (e.g. GZQO-DEMO)"; an amendment is sent under the study's own id, and nothing on the page says that the same id makes the next version
findings.expected: the protocol page says how an amendment is sent (the study's id, the next version)

findings.claim: amendment step 18: "Changes since 1.0.0" names one criterion (INC-01, new wording), but approving 1.1.0 asks the PI to open all four amber rows again (1.0.0 asked three)
findings.expected: the changed criteria are the ones to look at again, or the page says why every row is

findings.claim: amendment step 18: the change reads "INC-01 · new wording" with the earlier wording struck through; the new wording is only in the table below
findings.expected: the change shows the old and the new wording side by side

findings.claim: amendment step 21: the list links' names end with their count ("Approved and contacted (n)"); the walk finds the link by the start of its name (as H-20 F-05)
findings.expected: a link named by its list

findings.claim: amendment step 21: the patient approached under 1.0.0 is listed with the mark, but no page says which criteria version the mark was made on
findings.expected: the mark shows its version where the version decides the re-screen list
